data.name: Lateefa
data.gender_notes: Lateefa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Lateefa (لطيفة) means 'delicate, tender' or 'gentle, mild'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'latifah', which signifies subtlety and refinement. It is a beautiful and graceful name for a little girl. The name Lateefa carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lateefa usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle soul, close to Allah
data.etymology: Lateefa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lateefa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: لطيفة
in_arabic.meaning: لطيفة تعني اللطف والرقة في المعاملة والكلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لطيفة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ل ط ف' والذي يعني اللطف والرقة في المعاملة والكلام، ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الزمر الآية 18 'وَيُدخِلُهُمُ الجِنانَ الَّتي وَهَبَها لَهُم بِإِذنِهِم وَمَدىٰ لَهم فيها مِنَ الأَنعامِ وَالأَولادِ لَطِيفًا مِمّا يَأكُلونَ'، يدل على معنى اللطف والرزق الحسن، وفي التقاليد الإسلامية، يعتبر اسم لطيفة من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الصفات الحميدة مثل اللطف والرقة في التعامل.

in_urdu.name: لطیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: لطیفہ کا مطلب ہے کوکب سے نرمی اور ملائمیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام لطیفہ عربی جڑ 'ل ط ف' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نرمی، ملائمیت اور رقت، اسلامی تقالید میں، لطیفہ جیسے ناموں کو اچھے کردار کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے، جیسے کہ نرمی، رقت، اور حسن معاشرت، یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ خوبصورت معنی اور خوبصورت لفظی ساخت رکھتا ہے.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lateefa is common among predominantly Muslim communities, particularly in the Middle East and South Asia. It is a name that represents the delicate nature of women and girls, emphasizing their refined and gentle character. In many Islamic cultures, the virtues of purity, grace, and tenderness are highly valued and celebrated, making a name like Lateefa a fitting choice for a young girl.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its cultural significance, the name Lateefa holds spiritual significance for Muslims, as it is a reminder of the tender and gentle nature of God. In many Islamic teachings, God is described as being 'the Most Gentle and Kind' (Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim), emphasizing His mercy, compassion, and loving-kindness towards all of His creation. By giving a child the name Lateefa, parents are not only bestowing a beautiful, elegant name upon them, but they are also reminding them of the divine attributes of God, and the importance of embodying those qualities in their own lives.
